title: Maximum water extent
description: Every location ever detected as water, 1984 to 2024. From the [GSW v1.5 Data Users Guide](https://storage.googleapis.com/water-world/downloads_ancillary/DataUsersGuidev2024_v.5.pdf): "The Maximum Water Extent provides information on all the locations ever detected as water over the 41-year period. It is the union of all the other datasets." The collection holds the 504 upstream 10° × 10° tiles as items, copied byte for byte (0.00025° grid, EPSG:4326, uint8, nodata 255), and one global overview COG at 0.004° for display. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for access patterns.
